name: Bakunyuu Mesugaki Ojou-sama to no Shujuu Mazo Ecchi
original_name: 爆乳メスガキお嬢様との主従マゾエッチ
source:
As a form of payment for your father’s debt you were bought by a female young lady and kept as a dog.
Can you withstand the temptation of her big tits?
